title: File:Chiang Mai City Map for Inthawichayanon 1893.png
author: Unknown authorUnknown author
credit: The Fine Arts Office, Chiang Mai
description: Historic map of Chiang Mai city for King Inthawichayanon (1817-1897), dated 1893. The city was protected by an inner wall (brick wall), an outer wall (earth wall), 2 moats and multiple city gates. Each gate is a barbican. Note: the map is a bit blurry. Another version of this map is at the National Museum, Bangkok.
